stages.title: Choose the players
Read their records
Set the difficulty
Choose the winner
Award XP for odds, margin and critical rolls
Update streaks
Update ratings
Announce the challenge
stages.source: ${attacker} challenges ${defender}! ${if self == 1}Mirror match: exhibition rules.${else}Roll for initiative!${end}

stages.title: Show the die and difficulty
stages.source: • NEED: ${difficulty}+ on a D20 (${chance}% chance). • ROLLED: ${attacker} rolled ${roll}/20. • ${if roll == 1}CRITICAL FAILURE!${else}${if roll == 20}CRITICAL SUCCESS!${else}${if won == 1}SUCCESS!${else}FAILED!${end}${end}${end}

stages.title: Self-fight scenes (no progress)
stages.source: ${if self == 1}${random.pick "${attacker} hurt themself in their confusion! It was super embarrassing." "${attacker} challenged their reflection. The mirror filed a restraining order." "${attacker} got their ass kicked by their shadow. A flawless demonstration of clownery." "${attacker} rolled initiative against their last brain cell. The brain cell fled." "${attacker} cast Fireball at their feet. The dungeon master needs a drink." "${attacker} used Self-Destruct! The audience politely stepped back. Death" "${attacker} tried to parry an intrusive thought and punched their own face." "${attacker} fought their inner demons. The demons asked for a different party." "${attacker} defeated their trousers. Please close the curtains, you menace." "${attacker} failed a wisdom save against a revolving door."} No XP, wins, losses or rating changes.${end}

stages.title: Critical failure scenes
stages.source: ${if self == 0}${if roll == 1}${random.pick "${attacker} trips over a banana and critically fails to remain upright. Death" "${attacker} rolls to intimidate a chair. The chair wins." "${attacker} swings so hard their weapon joins another adventuring party." "${attacker} casts a spell with the microphone muted. Nothing happens." "${attacker} mistakes the mimic for a loot chest. The loot bites back." "${attacker} fails the tutorial. Even the goblins look concerned."}${end}${end}

stages.title: Critical success scenes
stages.source: ${if self == 0}${if roll == 20}${random.pick "${attacker} lands a legendary finishing blow. The bard is already writing the song. Death" "${attacker} used Hyper Beam! It was super effective!" "${attacker} parries fate itself and lands the final strike." "${attacker} summons a spectral goose. Peace was never an option." "${attacker} lands a sneak attack in broad daylight. Nobody questions it." "${attacker} wins so decisively the dungeon master checks the dice."}${end}${end}

stages.title: Ordinary wins, close misses and defeats
stages.source: ${if self == 0 && roll > 1 && roll < 20}${if won == 1}${random.pick "${attacker} breaks through the guard with a perfectly timed counterattack!" "${attacker} lands the winning strike. Loot goblin instincts immediately activate." "${attacker} wins the skill check. The party erupts into questionable applause." "${attacker} dodges, feints and sends their opponent back to the tavern." "${attacker} rolls through the attack. Somewhere, a bonfire has been lit." "${attacker} wins! The quest log updates: act surprised."}${else}${if roll == difficulty - 1}${random.pick "${defender} dodges by one hit point, then lands the winning counterattack!" "${attacker} misses by a whisker. The dice demand a sacrifice." "${defender} passes the saving throw with a suspiciously smug grin." "${attacker} almost lands the combo, then presses the wrong key." "${defender} wins the duel by the width of a goblin toenail." "${attacker} needed just one more point. The bard plays a tiny violin."}${else}${random.pick "${defender} parries and wins the duel. The healer refuses responsibility." "${attacker} attacks the tank and discovers why that was a bad idea." "${defender} counters with Vicious Mockery. Emotional damage!" "${attacker} drinks a potion labelled probably fine. It was not fine." "${defender} wins the encounter. The respawn screen offers unsolicited advice." "${attacker} loses the duel but insists it was lag."}${end}${end}${end}

stages.title: Award summary and progression
stages.source: ${if self == 0}• RESULT: ${winner} wins (+${xpAward} XP); ${loser} loses (-${xpLoss} XP).${end}
